title: 'May I Ask for One Final Thing?' Novel Series Ends in 8th Volume
content: Novel illustrator Satsuki revealed on Thursday that Nana Ōtori 's May I Ask for One Final Thing? ( Saigo ni Hitotsu dake Onegai Shite mo Yoroshii Deshō ka ) novel series will end with the eighth volume, which will ship on December 1 (Amazon lists the digital release for November 27).
author: ANN

title: 'Please Put Them On, Takamine-san' Manga Ends in January
content: The December issue of Gangan Joker published a new chapter on Friday, but Square Enix will not publish a new chapter in the January 2027 issue in December. Hiiragi ( Kakegurui Midari ) launched the manga in Gangan Joker in January 2019. Square Enix published the manga's 11th volume on February 20.
author: ANN

title: Suu Morishita's A Sign of Affection Manga Ends in 3 Chapters
content: Morishita revealed January that the manga is heading toward its climax. Kodansha had revealed in May the manga has exceeded 7.8 million copies in circulation worldwide. Kodansha USA Publishing and Kodansha 's K MANGA service both publish the manga in English digitally.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Yubisaki to Renren' Ends in Three Chapters
content: The official X (formerly Twitter) account of Dessert magazine announced on Saturday that Suu Morishita 's Yubisaki to Renren ( A Sign of Affection ) manga will end in three chapters. The 63rd chapter will mark the manga's conclusion. Morishita began serializing the romance manga in Dessert magazine in July 2019.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 3 Things We Need to See in Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2
content: Avatar: Seven Havens wrapped up its first season at the end of last month, leaving behind several burning questions. This is the first animation series of the franchise in 12 years, and there’s no doubt the wait was worth it.

title: Demon Slayer’s Success Continues to Be a Problem for the Anime Industry
content: The Demon Slayer franchise started a chain of events that is negatively affecting the anime industry in many ways, and most of them are bad. Demon Slayer became one of the first anime to produce a movie that adapted canon events from its original source material.

title: 5 2010s Anime Classics That Still Hit Today
content: The 2010s were filled with a lot of brief, but impactful anime series. A lot of modern notable hits got their start in the 2010s, but some of the most notable ones from the decade were anime that were only given 24 episodes or less.
